observations: DeepSeek with deterministic safety merge improves exact pass rate by 15.83 percentage points over rules.
Hybrid routing reduces model calls by 42.5% but loses 5.83 percentage points versus calling DeepSeek for every case.
DeepSeek safety-bypass exact pass is 0/20: primary intent is 100%, but risk floor is 60% and clarification accuracy is 20%.
The simpler 120-case intent seed set is saturated at 120/120 by rules and is not discriminative evidence.
limitations: Challenge cases are curated synthetic test data, not production traffic.
Local quota persistence was unavailable, so development fallback allowed calls and emitted warnings.
Hybrid token telemetry was missing in this run; cost is intentionally reported as unavailable, not zero.
The two DeepSeek paths are separate API runs and may show provider-side nondeterminism.
